name: STEM+ Explorers
street_address: MKA Upper School Campus, 6 Lloyd Road
description_short: Four week STEM program at Montclair Kimberley Academy's Upper School for rising 6th to 9th graders, taken by the week. Mornings are core courses in lab science, fabrication, engineering and coding plus an arts elective; afternoons are a weekly team design challenge that opens with a field trip.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund less the non-refundable $125 deposit until February 28; 50% refund less the deposit from March 1; no refunds after March 31.
notes: Full day (9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.) is $850 a week; morning only (9 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.) is $425 a week. Weeks can be taken singly. Students bring lunch; snacks are offered. Non-MKA students use a school laptop on campus and may be charged $250 if it is damaged. Limited financial assistance goes only to MKA families already approved for aid. 2027 dates are not yet posted.
